# OperationResult

Type alias · [Source](https://github.com/schmayterling/hibi/blob/main/src/shared/foundation-contracts.ts#L109)

Services can narrow the failure codes they return.

```typescript
type OperationResult<T, Code extends FailureCode = FailureCode> =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: T }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly code: Code; readonly message: string }
```
